title: 第13章 不用演戏了动手第14章 安敢坏我大计
lines: 波塞冬与哈迪斯不再隐藏气息，如同两道陨星，从侧方悍然撞入怪物军团的阵列。
海蓝色的狂涛神力与漆黑如墨的死亡阴影同时爆发，瞬间清空了一大片区域，无数怪物在惨叫中化为齑粉。
怪物军团的反应不可谓不快，但波塞冬与哈迪斯的目标很明确，直指中央的坎珀！
“吼——！何人胆敢擅闯禁地？！”
坎珀那数个头颅同时发出咆哮，她巨大的身躯却异常灵活，瞬间转身，锁链与巨斧带着撕裂空间的气势迎向攻击。
砰！铛！
攻击被坎珀轻松挡下，她那双属于人类女性的眼睛扫过来袭者。
“这股气息......是你们！克洛诺斯大人的叛逆子嗣！蓝头发的波塞冬，黑头发的哈迪斯！”
她立刻认出了敌人，同时迅速指挥军团合围，断掉两人的退路。
“既然自投罗网，就别想逃了！抓住你们，克洛诺斯大人定会重重赏赐于我！”
坎珀步步紧逼，攻势凶猛，仿佛胜券在握。
这并非她盲目自大。
她奉命镇守塔耳塔洛斯入口，十年如一日，未曾离开。虽然听闻过前线战况，知道这几位神子实力强悍，但并未亲身领教过。
在她看来，波塞冬与哈迪斯虽强，但自己拥有绝对的地利，兵力优势以及强大的个体实力，优势在我，擒下或击杀他们，并非不可能。
而波塞冬与哈迪斯则默契地开始演戏。
他们展现出“足够强大以致于坎珀必须全力以赴”，却又“似乎稍逊一筹，逐渐被压制”的姿态。
且战且退，将坎珀及其主力军团慢慢引离塔耳塔洛斯的入口区域。
既要让战斗看起来足够激烈真实，不让坎珀起疑，又要控制节奏，避免真的被围死或过早结束战斗。
轰隆隆隆！
就在这时，塔耳塔洛斯方向传来了沉闷而震动，仿佛有巨物在撞击青铜大门。
但在盖亚神力的掩护下，这股冲击并未扩散到外界。
与此同时，宙斯正屏息凝神，观察着战局。
他必须等待，等待波塞冬和哈迪斯将坎珀及其主力引到足够远，注意力被完全吸引过去的那一刻。
终于！
当坎珀为了彻底擒获这两个重要战利品，将绝大部分兵力都投入围攻，时——
宙斯动了！
他的身形如电，如瞬移般闪现在了塔耳塔洛斯的青铜大门前。
他取出盖亚暗中偷来的由克洛诺斯神力凝结而成的钥匙，插入了锁孔。
咔、咔、咔——
沉重的青铜大门缓缓开启，首先映入宙斯眼帘的，是三尊如同小山般巍峨的独眼巨人。
他们额头上唯一的巨眼，在黑暗中闪烁着光泽，充满了原始的力量与被压抑已久的愤怒。
更深处，则是形态更加惊人，仿佛噩梦具现化般的百臂巨人。五十个头，一百只手臂，每个头颅都表情各异，却统一散发着对克洛诺斯刻骨的恨意；每一条手臂都蕴藏着足以撕碎山峰的恐怖力量。
content_en:
boom! ! ! !
Poseidon and Hades no longer concealed their auras, and like two meteors, they crashed into the array of monster legions from the side.
The sea-blue raging divine power and the ink-black shadow of death erupted at the same time, instantly clearing a large area, and countless monsters turned into powder in the screams.
"Enemy attack!!!"
The reaction of the monster army was not unpleasant, but Poseidon and Hades had a clear goal, aiming directly at Camper in the center!
"Hoo! Who dares to trespass into the forbidden area?!"
Kemper's several heads roared at the same time, but her huge body was extremely flexible. She turned around in an instant, and the chains and giant ax faced the attack with the momentum of tearing the space.
Bang! clang!
The attack was easily blocked by Camper, and her eyes of a human woman glanced at the attacker.
"This aura...is you! The rebellious descendants of Lord Cronus! The blue-haired Poseidon and the black-haired Hades!"
She immediately recognized the enemy, and quickly commanded the legion to encircle them, cutting off the two men's retreat.
"Since you have thrown yourself into a trap, don't even think about escaping! If I catch you, Lord Cronus will definitely reward me heavily!"
Camper pressed forward step by step, attacking fiercely, as if he had a chance to win.
This is not because she is blindly arrogant.
She was ordered to guard the entrance to Tartarus, and she never left for ten years. Although I have heard about the battles on the front lines and know that these sons of gods are powerful, I have never experienced them personally.
In her opinion, although Poseidon and Hades are strong, they have absolute geographical advantages, military superiority and strong individual strength. The advantage lies with me. It is not impossible to capture or kill them.
Poseidon and Hades began to act in unison.
They showed themselves to be "strong enough that Camper had to go all out" but "seemed to be slightly inferior and gradually suppressed".
Fight and retreat, slowly leading Kemper and his main army away from the entrance area of ​​Tartarus.
It was necessary to make the battle look intense and real enough to prevent Camper from becoming suspicious, but also to control the pace to avoid being really surrounded or ending the battle prematurely.
Rumble, rumble!
At this moment, there was a dull and shaking sound from the direction of Tartarus, as if something huge was hitting the bronze door.
But under the cover of Gaia's divine power, this impact did not spread to the outside world.
At the same time, Zeus was holding his breath and observing the battle situation.
He had to wait, wait for the moment when Poseidon and Hades lured Kemper and his main force far enough that his attention was completely drawn to them.
finally!
When Camper devoted most of his troops to the siege in order to completely capture these two important trophies,——
Zeus moved!
His figure was like lightning, and he appeared in front of the bronze gate of Tartarus as if teleporting.
He took out the key condensed by Cronus' divine power that Gaia had secretly stolen and inserted it into the keyhole.
Click, click, click——
The heavy bronze door slowly opened, and the first thing that caught Zeus's eyes were three cyclops as towering as hills.
The single giant eye on their forehead shone in the darkness, full of raw power and long-repressed anger.
Deeper, there is a hundred-armed giant with an even more astonishing form, as if it were the embodiment of a nightmare. Fifty heads and one hundred arms, each with a different expression, but uniformly exuding a deep hatred for Cronus; each arm contains terrifying power that can tear the mountain apart.
title_en: Chapter 13: No need to act Chapter 14: How dare you spoil my plan
